name: Atucha-II
summary: The Atucha-II experiment operates a gram-scale Skipper-CCD inside reactor containment in Argentina. Its close proximity and single-electron charge resolution make it a testbed for low-energy reactor-neutrino and exotic-particle interactions.
detection_principle: Repeated charge sampling in silicon resolves ionization with sub-electron readout noise. A cryogenic sensor, lead and polypropylene shielding, and reactor-on/off samples characterize low-energy backgrounds and support CEvNS and new-particle searches.

results.summary: The initial campaign established sub-electron detector performance inside containment; the joint CONNIE/Atucha analysis set millicharged-particle constraints rather than a neutrino discovery.
